notes.title: ME WITH ME now Have WorkShop Available
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43107675/4863e7dc24edfe14220731b628969443575f676e.png[/img]
With a game we currently have, a lot of players have contacted me and asked if we can make the gameplay even longer? we simply say: "YES", and with this workshop, we can also receive your idea and sprite for our game and make it EVEN better than just by ourselves. We're now working on other games and this game as well, as we all know how cute is the "Dark cat", maybe you can save it by giving us more and more ideas to revive this little creature, until then "Thanks for playing" - from MeWithMe developer team
In short, we will receive: 
- Your sprite for mobs, cat, map element etc.
- Your designed-level as image

Thanks to everybody for all the feedback and review reports during the first week of release. We still updating so keep it tight!


Our Gmail: teamfortress2vn@gmail.com
We'll happy to receive any review and comment
